title: She Mistook Me For Staff. I 'Helped' Her Anyway.
script: I was restocking my own cart at the hardware store when a woman grabbed my arm and demanded I find her a specific faucet in 'the employee discount color.' I don't work there. I've never worked there. But she was already mid-rant about customer service, so I decided to help. I walked her straight to the most expensive faucet in the store, told her with a completely straight face that it was on 'manager clearance' if she asked for it by name at the register, and wished her luck. She marched up, demanded the discount loudly, by name, in front of an actual employee, who had no idea what she was talking about. The manager got called. The real story came out fast, security footage of me in my own clothes included. She stormed out without her faucet, and I finished picking my paint samples in peace.
